cards.title: Meta Launches Algorithm Control Feature
cards.body: Meta announced "Your Algorithm" on Facebook, giving users greater control over their feed. The feature was first launched on Instagram and represents the platform's latest effort to increase user transparency.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Stress-Tests Autonomous Systems
cards.body: University of Michigan spinout uses AI agents and interactive simulation to test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

cards.title: Pluto Security Raises $42M for AI Security
cards.body: Enterprise security startup Pluto Security raised $42M as companies face new vulnerabilities from widespread AI tool adoption. The funding reflects growing concerns about unexpected security gaps in enterprise systems.

cards.title: Google Play Enables Private AI-Built Apps
cards.body: Google now allows developers to build and use personal Android apps created with AI without publishing to Play Store. The move makes it easier to create private, customized applications.

cards.title: Satlyt Launches Open Orbital Computing Platform
cards.body: Satlyt positions itself as the Android of orbital computing, offering open software for multiple satellite operators. The approach contrasts with SpaceX's closed, integrated iPhone-style model.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Kicks Off Today
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 officially begins at San Francisco's Moscone West with 10,000+ tech leaders and founders. The three-day event features conversations and startup innovations shaping the industry.

cards.title: X Bundles Premium, Grok, and Cursor
cards.body: SpaceXSI created new X Subscription combining X Premium with AI tools Grok and Cursor. Plans range from $8 to $200 monthly with bundled access to multiple services.

cards.title: Disrupt Stage Lineup Revealed
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt Stage features Max Hodak, Mark Wahlberg, and Benchmark partners across three days. Early registration saves up to $100 with second pass at 50% off.

cards.title: Amex Launches Framework for AI Purchases
cards.body: American Express introduced a framework ensuring AI agents only execute authorized purchases by users. The measure aims to prevent costly errors and disputes as AI shopping grows.

cards.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy
cards.body: Interactive chatbot platform Character.AI filed for bankruptcy after five years in operation. Disney will acquire some assets for $20 million.

cards.title: Meta Releases Muse Wonder Frontier Model
cards.body: Meta launched Muse Wonder, a larger, more capable frontier model following Muse Spark. The new models show higher benchmark scores and improved performance on complex tasks like coding.

cards.title: WindBorne Wins $50M Air Force Contract
cards.body: Weather prediction startup WindBorne secured a U.S. Air Force contract worth nearly $50 million. The company uses weather balloons and AI to improve weather forecasting capabilities.

cards.title: Honeyjar Launches AI-Powered PR Tools
cards.body: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve public relations and communications across companies. The platform addresses widespread frustration with traditional PR processes.

cards.title: Microsoft President Calls for AI Regulation
cards.body: Microsoft president Brad Smith urged urgent AI regulation, noting AI has less oversight than washing machines. He identified the UK as best positioned to drive regulatory frameworks.

cards.title: Blueprints AI Generates Permit-Ready Plans
cards.body: Santa Monica startup Blueprints AI developed software producing code-compliant construction blueprints from photos, PDFs, or sketches. The bootstrapped company streamlines architectural planning processes.

cards.title: Disrupt 2026 Starts Tomorrow in SF
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 begins tomorrow with 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech leaders at Moscone West. Last 24 hours to secure up to $100 in ticket savings.

cards.title: Former Plaud Exec Raises $26M Series
cards.body: Former Plaud executive raised $26M for AI app that monitors user activity in background. The company believes continuous data collection enables better personalized assistance.

cards.title: Apple HomeView Smart Home Device Coming
cards.body: Apple's long-rumored smart home product now has a confirmed name: HomeView with expected launch date. The device represents Apple's latest attempt at smart home market dominance.

cards.title: 48 Hours Until Disrupt 2026 Launch
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 begins in under 48 hours at San Francisco's Moscone West. Save up to $100 on passes before prices increase at the door.

cards.title: AI Industry Considers NDA Transparency Push
cards.body: Industry debates whether eliminating NDAs could address data center opposition and communication problems. Data center moratoriums pose challenges for AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: Open Models: Benefits vs. Risks Debate
cards.body: Anthropic released a report arguing that powerful open AI models like GLM-5.3 pose major cyberattack risks. The debate centers on whether open models' benefits outweigh their security vulnerabilities.

cards.title: AI Labs Acquiring Data From Defunct Startups
cards.body: AI companies are purchasing digital archives and codebases from failed startups to train their models. One founder netted $25,000 selling his startup's data to AI labs.

cards.title: AI Models Struggle With Refusal Capabilities
cards.body: Current AI chatbots are trained to refuse harmful prompts, but researchers question if this safety measure is overestimated. The AI industry may be placing too much confidence in these refusal mechanisms.

cards.title: Epic Games Shifts to AI-First Development
cards.body: Epic Games is reportedly pivoting its game development strategy toward an AI-first model. The shift could reshape how video games are created and designed.

cards.title: Claude AI Submits False Murder Tip to Police
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted a false murder tip to Philadelphia police, highlighting serious reliability concerns. The incident raises questions about AI systems providing information to law enforcement.

cards.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon Model
cards.body: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is rolling out in the Gemini app and Antigravity platform. Access to the new model requires a paid subscription.
